intro.h2: A painting contractor in San Antonio, TX, who shows up when it counts
paragraphs: Painting Pro Experts is a Latino-owned painting contractor in San Antonio, TX, run by Abel and a crew that customers describe as family oriented. We paint houses and offices, repair drywall and take on bathroom rebuilds when water gets where it should not.

What sets us apart is how fast we move when a home is hurting. After the big winter storm in Texas, Abel came out right away to repair one family's drywall. When another homeowner called about water damage, he gave an estimate and the crew was remodeling her whole bathroom the next day. Larger jobs get the same care: one business owner had several rooms painted in different colors and would hire us again.

items.name: Interior painting
items.blurb: Walls, ceilings and trim inside your home, painted with clean lines and tidy edges. Drywall painting is one of the topics customers bring up most in our Google reviews. Tell us the rooms and the colors you have in mind, and we will plan the job around your household.

items.name: Drywall repair and painting
items.blurb: Cracks, holes and water spots get cut out, patched, textured and painted to blend with the rest of the wall. After the winter storm hit Texas, Abel came out right away to repair one family's drywall, and they say the work was fast and well done.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling after water damage
items.blurb: Water damage cannot wait. One homeowner called us on short notice, Abel came out with an estimate, and the following day the crew started remodeling her entire bathroom. She says the family loves the result. Call us if a leak has left your bathroom torn up.

items.blurb: Offices and work spaces with several rooms and several colors are a good fit for our crew. On one commercial interior job, a client says Abel and his team finished every room with a high level of quality and professionalism. We work around your schedule so business can keep going.

why_choose_us.h2: Why San Antonio homeowners call Abel

items.title: Quick response
items.text: Two reviewers say Abel came out fast: right after the Texas winter storm for drywall repairs, and on short notice for a water-damaged bathroom that the crew started the very next day.

items.title: A family-oriented business
items.text: We are a Latino-owned company, and one customer recommends us to anyone as a family oriented business. You deal with Abel and his crew, not a call center.

items.title: Quality on bigger jobs too
items.text: A commercial client with several rooms in different colors says the work was done with a high level of quality and professionalism, and that he would use us again.

items.title: Open seven days
items.text: We answer the phone every day of the week: 7 AM to 6 PM on weekdays, 8 AM to 6 PM on Saturday and 8 AM to 3 PM on Sunday.

about.text: Painting Pro Experts is a Latino-owned painting business based on Red Oak Vista in San Antonio. Abel leads the crew and is the person customers name in their reviews, whether he is meeting a family after a storm or walking a business owner through a multi-room paint job. We keep things personal and family oriented, and we thank customers personally when they take the time to review us. Our Google profile holds more than 1,700 photos of homes and projects. Call Abel to talk through yours.

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (210) 776-8203 any day of the week and tell us about the rooms, the drywall damage or the bathroom you need help with.

steps.title: Estimate at your home
steps.text: Abel comes out, looks at the space and gives you an estimate, as he did for the homeowner with the water-damaged bathroom.

steps.title: Prep and repair
steps.text: We protect floors and furniture, then fix damaged drywall and surfaces so the paint goes on smooth and even.

steps.title: Paint or rebuild
steps.text: The crew paints or remodels as agreed, working room by room and keeping you updated on progress.

steps.title: Final look together
steps.text: We walk the finished space with you so you can check every wall and corner before we pack up.

items.name: Jackie J.
items.text: Abel was very professional and helpful with the entire process. He came out to my house right away after the big winter storm we had here in Texas. items.text: Thank you Abel for coming out to help us in such a short notice. We had water damage and needed someone to help us. Abel came out and gave us an estimate and the following day he was with crew remodeling my entire Bathroom. We love the outcome. Recommend 100%

items.name: Will S.
items.text: Abel and his team did a fantastic job on our commercial interior painting project. There were several rooms, with different colors and Abel and his team completed the project with a high level of quality and professionalism. I would definitely use them again.

service_area.h2: Painting contractor serving San Antonio, TX
service_area.text: Painting Pro Experts is based at 7902 Red Oak Vista in San Antonio, TX 78250. We work in homes and businesses around San Antonio. If you are not sure whether your neighborhood is on our route, call (210) 776-8203 and tell us where the job is. We are open every day of the week, so you can usually reach Abel the same day.

items.q: What kind of work does Painting Pro Experts do?
items.a: We paint home and business interiors, repair and paint drywall, and remodel bathrooms damaged by water. Our reviews mention drywall repairs after the Texas winter storm, a full bathroom remodel and a multi-room commercial paint job. Call us to describe your project and we will tell you if it is a fit.

items.q: Can you come out quickly after storm or water damage?
items.a: We try to. After the winter storm, Abel came out right away to repair one customer's drywall. Another homeowner called on short notice about water damage, got an estimate, and the crew was remodeling her bathroom the following day. Call (210) 776-8203 and we will see how soon we can get there.

items.q: Do you give estimates before starting?
items.a: Yes. Abel comes out to look at the space and gives you an estimate before any work begins, so you know what to expect. Call us or use the estimate request form on this page, and include a few photos of the rooms or damage if you have them.
We are open seven days a week. Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 6 PM, Saturday from 8 AM to 6 PM and Sunday from 8 AM to 3 PM. Call (210) 776-8203 during those hours to reach us directly.

items.q: Do you paint businesses as well as homes?
items.a: Yes. We have painted commercial interiors with several rooms in different colors. That client says Abel and his team completed the project with a high level of quality and professionalism and that he would use us again. Tell us your schedule and we will plan around your business hours.

final_cta.h2: Need a painter in San Antonio this week?
final_cta.text: Call Abel any day of the week to talk through your painting, drywall or bathroom project.
